[DB Instance: Redshift Retail]

select	"a11"."line_id" AS "line_id",
	"a11"."order_id" AS "order_id",
	"a11"."line_number" AS "line_number",
	"a11"."product_id" AS "product_id",
	"a11"."quantity" AS "quantity",
	"a11"."unit_price" AS "unit_price",
	"a11"."line_amount" AS "line_amount",
	"a11"."line_cost" AS "line_cost"
from	"analytics"."retail"."fact_order_lines"	"a11"

select	"a12"."order_id" AS "order_id",
	"a12"."order_ts" AS "order_ts",
	"a12"."order_date" AS "order_date",
	"a12"."customer_id" AS "customer_id",
	"a12"."store_id" AS "store_id",
	"a12"."order_status" AS "order_status",
	"a12"."order_amount" AS "order_amount",
	"a12"."discount_amount" AS "discount_amount",
	"a12"."shipping_amount" AS "shipping_amount",
	"a12"."item_count" AS "item_count"
from	"analytics"."retail"."fact_orders"	"a12"

select	"a13"."product_id" AS "product_id",
	"a13"."product_name" AS "product_name",
	"a13"."category" AS "category",
	"a13"."subcategory" AS "subcategory",
	"a13"."brand" AS "brand",
	"a13"."unit_cost" AS "unit_cost"
from	"analytics"."retail"."dim_product"	"a13"

select	"a14"."date_key" AS "date_key",
	"a14"."day_of_week" AS "day_of_week",
	"a14"."week_start_monday" AS "week_start_monday",
	"a14"."week_start_sunday" AS "week_start_sunday",
	"a14"."month_start" AS "month_start",
	"a14"."month_name" AS "month_name",
	"a14"."quarter" AS "quarter",
	"a14"."year" AS "year",
	"a14"."fiscal_year" AS "fiscal_year",
	"a14"."fiscal_quarter" AS "fiscal_quarter"
from	"analytics"."retail"."dim_date"	"a14"
